coordinate_definition: Native Odometry XY metres; yaw radians CCW from its +X toward +Y
elapsed_time_definition: Simulation time since dispatch_clock_s; only post-dispatch odometry enters task metrics; ideal 2D starts at the same elapsed zero

operating_envelope.frame: Frozen native-odometry start; along axis is initial yaw, cross axis is its left normal
operating_envelope.violation_definition: Count entries outside this closed coordinate rectangle in received task observations; no collision or energy claim

hold_rule: Consecutive received poses inside the radius spanning hold_sim_s; gap limited by frozen startup config

reference_model.model: Ideal 2D point kinematics with instantaneous velocity along the start-to-goal line; no WAM-V thrust, turning, waves or drag dynamics
reference_model.comparison_boundary: The realized start, yaw, goal, nominal speed, arrival radius, observed hold rule, time budget and envelope are shared; dynamics are deliberately different
